headline: My Water Heater Leaked on a Sunday – Who Can Help?
articleBody: A leaking water heater is never fun, and finding it on a Sunday morning can feel like a disaster. But don't worry, even on weekends, you've got options in the Las Vegas Valley! Many plumbing companies, like CG Plumbing Solutions, offer weekend services specifically for situations like this. The first thing you should do is try to turn off the water supply to the water heater, usually via a valve on the cold water inlet pipe. If it's a gas water heater, also turn off the gas supply. Then, describe the symptom and its location to the plumber. It helps them prepare. Before they arrive, clear any clutter around the water heater so the technician has easy access. You might also want to take a few photos of the leak. When you call, it's always smart to ask if weekend rates are different from weekday rates and if the technician can likely complete the repair during the visit. Sometimes parts need to be ordered, but getting a diagnosis and temporary fix can prevent further damage. We're here for weekend water heater emergencies and scheduled services across Las Vegas and surrounding areas.
